- Blue was at green container slot 1 (position ~row 36, col 22)
These are not the same column positions. Purple is at col 28 in the red container, blue is at col 22 in the green container. So ACTION7 doesn't just swap items in the same column.
Actually wait, let me reconsider. Looking at the image:
- Red container has slots at columns ~22, 28, (connector at 34), 40
- Green container has slots at columns ~22, 28, 34, 40
So the columns align. Purple was at red container col 28, blue was at green container col 22. ACTION7 swapped these two. But they're at different columns...
Hmm, maybe ACTION7 swaps the first two items that are "out of order" according to some rule? Or maybe it's a specific puzzle mechanic I don't understand yet.
Let me try pressing ACTION7 again to see what happens.
